capabilities: Highlight selected text in Live Preview via a floating toolbar
Attach multiple typed comments to one highlight
Edit and delete individual comments by clicking badges
Configure annotation types with names, emojis, colors and unique tags
Store annotations as escaped Markdown with IDs, authors and dates
extras: Not yet listed in the community plugin directory; manual install from source requires Node.js 22+. Mobile usability is unverified, and annotations crossing Markdown formatting nodes may render as raw syntax.
intentEvidence: From the earlier Agent Annotations prototype
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to attach editable inline comments to selected text that stay readable in the Markdown file itself without a database or external service.

relations.evidence: Disable Agent Annotations before enabling Inline Notes. Do not run both on the same note.

summary: Text-highlight and inline-comment tool that stores annotations as plain Markdown syntax readable by people and AI agents.
